name: KY-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: R+20 partisan lean in a heavily Republican district
Incumbent Brett Guthrie running with a large financial edge ($4.7M raised vs. $7.5K)
Prediction markets price Guthrie at ~95% to win
No polling or expert ratings; challenger nearly unfunded
model.rationale: Guthrie is a well-funded incumbent in an R+20 district, while Democrat Megan Wingfield has raised almost nothing and markets give her roughly a 4% chance. Nothing in the evidence suggests movement away from a Safe R rating.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or major outside spending against Guthrie would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Kentucky's 2nd District is a deeply Republican seat with a roughly 20-point partisan lean, and Brett Guthrie is seeking another term as its incumbent. He holds an overwhelming financial advantage, having raised about $4.7 million with $1.7 million on hand, while Democratic challenger Megan Wingfield has raised under $8,000. No outside groups are opposing Guthrie, and no independent polling of the race exists.

Prediction markets price Guthrie's chances at about 95 percent, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no ratings, no polls, and a nearly unfunded challenger, the race sits firmly in Safe R territory, with only a small chance of an upset.
